g.text: Low altitude · slow forward · 8 sec · wind only, no music
LIGHT: pre-sunrise blue, soft, motivated by horizon
Title card "twelve cats are still breathing" precedes.
5 sec hold · grainy IR · ICS archival · cat exits frame right
SOUND: night wind only · no narration over the exit
First sight of the animal. Eyeshine is the punctuation.
Right panel holds 3 beats longer · cut on narrator "Forget all of that."
LIGHT: L = warm gold; R = cool hard white
The substrate, sky, grass differ. Right panel wins.
Negative prompt watchpoint: zero acacia on right.
Parallel-to-ground glide · 6 sec · gazelle herd FG
LIGHT: low sun camera-left, long shadows right
Naming the place. Gazelle = prey base = stakes.
Followed by Land Cruiser dust trail (silhouette guard).
Hold 4 sec · mesh wire FG · archival video, slight crop
Closes on still: Kooshki head turned to camera, 3 sec silence
The mesh is the shot. The pacing is the gait.
No music yet. Pure archival texture.
6 months — the country fell in love
SC 4 · SH 5 · PHOTO MONTAGE · CU on iconic frame
4 archival photos, each held longer than the last · 14 sec total
MUSIC: single cello note enters here, low under wind
The script's only musical entrance. Protect.
